main_text.l: Sententia vero definitiva,ein Endurtheil/est quæ
principalem definit quæstionem, & imponit finem
negotio principali, quod fit vel condemnatione vel
absolutione. Atq; hæc (de prima Instantia: Sequitur
appellatio,unde oritur secunda Instantia.
Appellatio, ein beruffung zum höhern Richter/est
ab audientia minoris judicis, ad majorem, propter
gravamen illatum, provocatio.Nam si sententia ini-
qua condemnato videtur, appellare ab interlocuto-
ria per scriptum potest: A definitiva vero vel viva
voce, vel ex intervallo decem dierum in scriptis.Ju-
dex Apostolos (abfertigs brieffe) ad superiorem ju-
dicem appellanti impertit.
Si intra illud tempus non appellatur, Sententia in
rem judicatam transit, (gehet Das Urtheil in seine
Kraffi[?]) & petente parte pro qua pronunciatum est a
Judice Executioni satisfieri debet. Es soll die execu-
tion vnd vollziehung darauff folgen.
¶ His cognitis, studiosus adolescens Corpus Juris
legat, ut Imperat. monet. §. fin. Inst. de
pub. Jud.
FINIS.

page.notes: Ornament at the foot of the page, no text. Black letter German words are marked with bl; the mixed line "Es soll die execu-tion" is partly black letter and partly roman, which is marked as printed. "Kraffi" is doubtful (possibly "Krafft"). Printed "vnd" and "vrtheil" are given as "und" and "Urtheil" by the u/v rule. Printed "eft" is given as "est" by the long-s rule.
